title: Milwaukee Brewers defeat Tampa Bay Rays to become 1st-time World Series champions
summary: The scrappy Milwaukee Brewers captured the franchise's first World Series title, defeating the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 in Game 5 at Tropicana Field in St. Petersburg, Fla., Wednesday.

image.caption: William Contreras of the Milwaukee Brewers reacts after hitting an RBI double in the sixth inning of Game 5 of the World Series against the Tampa Bay Rays. The Brewers won the game 4-1 — to clinch the overall championship on Wednesday night. (Mike Stobe/Getty Images)

blocks.text: The small-ball Milwaukee Brewers playing in the smallest market in the majors are World Series champions for the first time in franchise history.
Milwaukee defeated Tampa 4-1 in Game 5 of the World Series at Tropicana Field in St. Petersburg, Fla.
Hey, Milwaukee: raise a beer and prepare for that parade.

Young ace Jacob Misiorowski threw 5 2/3 scoreless innings of two-hit ball, rookie Cooper Pratt got two more hits and two RBIs, and the Brewers beat the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 in Game 5 on Wednesday night to set off a long-awaited celebration among thousands of Brewers fans in attendance at Tropicana Field.
Members of the Tampa Bay Rays watch during the ninth inning of Game 5 of the World Series, which the team lost to the Brewers. (Kim Klement Neitzel/Imagn Images/Reuters)
Misiorowski left the game because of a right calf cramp. He got a standing ovation from the Brew-Crew fans, who took over the section behind Milwaukee's dugout for the last three games.
The 22-year-old Pratt set a Series rookie record with six straight hits before a sacrifice fly in the sixth inning. Jackson Chourio set a five-game Series record with 11 hits.

The World Series title comes in the 58th season for a franchise that began as the Seattle Pilots in 1969 and moved to Milwaukee the following year. The Brewers' only previous trip to the World Series in 1982 ended in heartbreak when they blew a 3-1 lead in the sixth inning of Game 7 and lost 6-3 to the St. Louis Cardinals.
